newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends firmer.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends firmer.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate ended firmer on Monday as liquidity tightened ahead of the end of the current reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.219 percent against Saturday's 5.163 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.00-5.10.
Dealers said the interbank rate may hit 5.50 percent on Tuesday.
The bond market was directionless, with players retreating to the sidelines before the New Year holiday. The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was traded at 6.17 earlier.-- Rachel Lee (5080815)
